title: Level Terms for Holds, Appeals, Reactivation and Reapplication — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the length of a hold, the appeal window after a deactivation and the reactivation terms vary by level as follows.

## Holds

| Level | A hold must end within (days of the hold start date) | Batches accepted before the hold still paid | In-app refresher required after a released hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 14 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 10 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 10 calendar days | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 7 calendar days | Yes | No |

## Appeals and reactivation

| Level | Appeal window after the deactivation date | Decision target for a submitted appeal | Deactivation reasons open to appeal | Reactivations an account may ever receive | Level after reactivation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 14 calendar days | 10 business days | Rating below floor; violation points; documents expired | 1 | The same level |
| Full-Service Shopper | 30 calendar days | 10 business days | Rating below floor; violation points; documents expired; zero-tolerance violation | 1 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 30 calendar days | 10 business days | The same four reasons | 1 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 30 calendar days | 7 business days | The same four reasons | 2 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 45 calendar days | 5 business days | The same four reasons | 2 | The entry level |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 45 calendar days | 5 business days | The same four reasons | 2 | The entry level |

## Reapplying after closure

At every level, a person whose account has been closed may apply again once 180 calendar days have passed since the closure.

## Points of difference

- A zero-tolerance deactivation is open to appeal on every Full-Service level and not at Shop-Only Shopper.
- Full-Service Shopper Diamond is the only level without the in-app refresher after a released hold, and has the shortest hold limit, 7 days.
- A hypothetical Full-Service Shopper Gold account that has already been reactivated once has one reactivation left; a Full-Service Shopper Silver account in the same position has none.
